blocks.text: Little did I know as I left a joint service interrogation exercise at Camp LeJeune, North Carolina, I was heading for an experience that would change my life forever. My first encounter with Chinese astrology was on a placemat in a Korean-Chinese restaurant not far from the base. It offered just a few words about each zodiac sign, yet those simple descriptions resonated deeply with me. I recognized not only myself in those brief phrases but also the personalities of friends and family born under different signs. That chance encounter sparked a curiosity that would eventually lead to a four-decade journey of discovery and guidance.
The Challenge of Decision-Making

Life is filled with crossroads like that one, moments when we must choose a direction without clearly seeing the path ahead. I had no idea how great an impact the decision to follow up on that spark of curiosity would have on my life. Perhaps you're facing a decision now, one you've been agonizing over for a while. The complexity can be overwhelming: relationships intertwine with career choices, financial considerations clash with emotional needs; and the weight of uncertainty presses down upon your shoulders.

To further complicate matters, many of us become trapped in limited perspectives when making decisions. We fixate on one or two factors while overlooking others that might offer valuable insight. Emotions cloud our judgment; fear narrows our vision; and we lose sight of what truly matters to us. In these moments, clarity seems impossibly distant.
A Mirror with Four Angles

There is hope. Throughout human history, many frameworks have been developed to navigate life's complexities. The approach I share in these pages draws from timeless wisdom but speaks to modern challenges. It invites you to examine your situation from multiple angles, not just the obvious ones, and discover considerations and solutions you might otherwise miss.

The framework I am presenting isn't about predicting an unchangeable fate. Rather, it's about illuminating the landscape before you and helping you choose with greater awareness and purpose. Like a mirror turned to catch light from different directions, it reveals truths that might otherwise remain hidden in shadow.
At its heart, the Mahjong Mirror employs four essential angles of reflection:
The First Angle: Your Central Theme, The gravitational force shaping your situation, the one thing that influences everything else in your life right now.
The Second Angle: Looking at Yourself, Understanding who you are, who you need to become, what you truly want, and what's happening in your life at this moment.
The Third Angle: Examining Your Opposition, The obstacles, challenges, and resistance you must navigate to reach your goals.
The Fourth Angle: Exploring Your Future, The probabilities and possibilities that await, both in the near term and beyond.

By the way, when I say you, I mean everyone. I have used this approach on three continents, in personal, family and business contexts, with CEOs, office staff and part-time workers. It can work for you too.
The Mirror That Reflects Truth

In Chinese philosophy, mirrors have long been symbols of truthtelling, not because they show us what we want to see, but because they reflect what actually is. The Mahjong Mirror I've developed over nearly four decades works similarly. It shows us our situations from angles we might not naturally consider by illuminating patterns and possibilities that remain hidden when we examine our lives from only one perspective.

Think of it this way: when you're lost in a forest, climbing to higher ground gives you a broader view of the landscape. You can see the path you've been on, identify obstacles ahead, and spot routes that weren't visible from ground level. The Four Angles of the Mahjong Mirror work the same way; they elevate your perspective so you can see your life's terrain more clearly.

This isn't about predicting a predetermined future or surrendering your agency to cosmic forces. Instead, it's about understanding the patterns and probabilities that shape your circumstances, much like a meteorologist helps you understand weather patterns so you can plan your day wisely.

What distinguishes the Mahjong Mirror from purely analytical approaches is its recognition that we are whole beings, thinking and feeling, logical and intuitive, individual and interconnected. Unlike purely spiritual approaches, it grounds insights in realistic assessment and practical planning. It honors both the wisdom of ancient traditions and the complexity of contemporary life.

You don't need mystical abilities or special cards to use these four angles. You need something more precious and powerful: the willingness to look honestly at your situation from perspectives you might naturally avoid, the courage to acknowledge both your authentic nature and the obstacles you face, and the wisdom to base your decisions on realistic probabilities rather than wishful thinking or fearful assumptions.
Your Path to Clearer Decisions

In the chapters that follow, we'll explore each angle in depth, learning to see through the eyes of ancient wisdom while walking the paths of modern life. You'll discover how to identify your own central themes, invisible threads that give meaning to your surface challenges. You'll learn to recognize your authentic nature beneath the roles and expectations that sometimes obscure your true self. You'll develop the courage to face opposition honestly, whether it comes from within or without. And you'll cultivate the skill of assessing probabilities realistically, neither inflating your chances through wishful thinking nor diminishing them through unnecessary fear.

This is the promise of the Mahjong Mirror: not that it will make your decisions for you, but that it will help you see your choices clearly enough to make them wisely. In a world that often pressures us to choose between head and heart, between tradition and innovation, between individual fulfillment and collective harmony, this framework offers a different possibility, the integration of wisdom that honors all aspects of our complex human nature.
The mirror awaits your honest gaze. What will you discover when you see your life reflected from four angles of truth?
The Dance of Interconnection
What makes this framework powerful is how these four angles dance together, each one informing and refining the others.

items: Understanding your central theme clarifies who you need to be.
Knowing yourself authentically reveals what opposition you'll face.
Acknowledging obstacles honestly allows you to assess probabilities realistically.
And understanding your odds helps you decide whether to proceed boldly, adjust your approach, or cultivate patience while circumstances shift.

blocks.text: This interconnectedness reflects one of the deepest insights of Chinese philosophy: nothing exists in isolation, but, rather, all aspects of life influence one another in an endless web of relationships. Your decisions ripple outward, affecting not just your immediate circumstances but the kind of person you become and the possibilities you create for the future. In the end, this is all connected by the central theme.
Why This Book, Why Now

While personal readings bring me great satisfaction, they reach only a limited audience. This book allows me to share these insights with a broader community of seekers. Unlike a reading, which might fade from memory, these pages offer a permanent resource you can revisit whenever life presents new challenges.

Additionally, recent advances in technology have made it possible to combine ancient wisdom with modern analytical tools, creating more comprehensive guidance systems. This convergence of tradition and innovation represents an exciting frontier in personal development, one that I'm eager to explore with you.
How to Use This Book

This book is organized to present my decision-making framework through four sections, each focused on one angle of the mirror, and concludes with an overall integration. Each section reveals what you can discover when you angle the mirror in that particular direction:
Section 1 addresses the gravitational force that shapes your current situation.
Section 2 explores matters concerning you personally, who you are, who you need to be, what you want, and what you're doing now.
Section 3 identifies potential challenges and provides recommendations for action.
Section 4 examines your probability of success, both short and long-term.

I have prepared a Mahjong spread (see Appendix 1) representing a real-life reading. As I share experiences throughout the book, I will include the meaning of relevant Mahjong cards. It's not necessary to know anything about Mahjong to get the full benefit of this book. I just want to show you how I've used the cards throughout the years with real people. You can take comfort in knowing this is not simply a theoretical work, but rather is based on over thirty years of experience. One more practical matter: you can approach this book in two ways. Read it from beginning to end to understand the complete framework through my experiences and stories. Or, after reading this introduction, you might prefer to jump to the appendix for a practical overview, then dive deeper into specific chapters that address your current concerns.
An Invitation to Journey Together

When I conclude a reading, I always remind my clients that our conversation marks not an ending but a beginning. The true work lies ahead, in reflection, in action, in the daily choices that gradually shape a life of greater harmony and purpose.

I extend the same invitation to you now. This book is not merely a collection of insights but a companion for your journey. Like water flowing over stones, life's challenges can either wear you down or polish you to a beautiful shine. The difference often lies in how you approach them.

As we explore these ancient wisdoms together, my hope is you'll discover not just answers to your immediate questions, but a deeper understanding of yourself and your place in the grand cycles of existence. The path to wisdom begins with a single step, I'm honored to walk beside you as you take it.
